_doc: Canonical wiring data for the memory system (KIT-DR-001). Logic lives in tools/lib/config.py; data lives here. Edit tracks, threads, sources, and check inventories here. setup.sh copies this template to instance/config.json. MANUAL.md section 2 describes every key.

checks._doc: Optional inventories for linkcheck and coherence. Each key is left out until it has entries; a missing key means none, and hub_ignore_ext defaults to [".pyc"].

loop._doc: The optional improvement loop (system/loop/README.md). It is off: no source may send until python3 tools/options.py on loop, and nothing is scheduled until python3 tools/loop/loops.py start. A change that passes is saved as a patch file; the loop never writes into this folder's files. A key left out takes its engine default; python3 tools/loop/lib/loop_config.py prints every key with the value in use and what it means. loop.token_ceiling (null by default: no ceiling) caps the tokens one cycle's model runs may spend.
